int_name: E ROOSEVELT BLVD & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The intersection is wide with multiple travel lanes and lacks visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. A large bus creates a significant visual obstruction, and the overall environment prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this multi-lane intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large bus is stopped near the intersection, blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk but no active traffic control or pedestrian refuge. The environment is characterized by high-speed design elements and long crossing distances, which increase pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal, stop sign, or refuge island.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide roadway and multi-lane configuration create long crossing distances and prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time and improve compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is highly car-oriented, featuring wide travel lanes and highway-style signage that prioritizes high-speed vehicle throughput. Pedestrian infrastructure is severely deficient, with no sidewalks and only faded crosswalk markings, while signage explicitly discourages or prohibits pedestrian activity.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkways
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks, forcing any pedestrians to walk on the grass or the road shoulder.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and highway-style signage encourage high vehicle speeds in an area with potential pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.
